record.note: Fell to 1-1 under HC Jesse Minter after a 24-17 home loss to the New Orleans Saints in Week 2 (2026-09-20) — blew a 14-3 lead; Minter cited third-down defense breakdowns and mental/operational penalties as the difference. Next up: Week 3 at Dallas Cowboys, a neutral-site game in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (2026-09-27).

coaching_change.headline: New head coach for 2026: Jesse Minter (4th HC in franchise history), replacing John Harbaugh after 18 seasons.
details: New special teams coordinator: Anthony Levine Sr.
Updated 2026-09-09: Minter named five permanent captains for 2026 — Lamar Jackson (QB), Derrick Henry (RB), Roquan Smith (ILB), Kyle Hamilton (S), Calais Campbell (DL).

Updated 2026-09-15: Minter picked up his first career win as a head coach in the Week 1 blowout at Indianapolis (41-23), notably played near his hometown of Yorktown, Indiana — greeted postgame by his family, including his father Rick, also on the Ravens coaching staff.

Updated 2026-09-17: Thursday practice report ahead of Week 2 vs. New Orleans (9/20) — WR Zay Flowers (hamstring), LT Ronnie Stanley (toe), and LG John Simpson (groin) did not practice; OLB Trey Hendrickson (hand) and CB T.J. Tampa (knee) limited. Roster moves: K Jake Moody released after Tyler Loop's strong Week 1 kicking; WR Chris Moore re-signed to the 53-man roster.

Updated 2026-09-18: Friday's final Week 2 injury report brought several downgrades — DT Nnamdi Madubuike (neck) and ILB Teddye Buchanan (knee) both upgraded from Limited to OUT; CB T.J. Tampa (knee) did not practice and was ruled OUT. WR Devontez Walker (groin) and S Keondre Jackson (shoulder) were upgraded to full practice, trending toward playing. OLB Trey Hendrickson (finger) and G John Simpson (groin) remain Questionable (Limited again Friday).

Updated 2026-09-19: WR Zay Flowers (hamstring), Doubtful after Friday's Limited practice, was downgraded further to OUT for Week 2 as a caution — team and reports (Ian Rapoport) describe it as not serious. Ravens also elevated OT Gerad Christian-Lichtenhan from the practice squad; reporters (ESPN's Jamison Hensley, The Athletic's Jeff Zrebiec) read this as a bad sign for Ronnie Stanley's toe injury — if Stanley sits, rookie Carson Vinson would start at left tackle, a tough early test against Saints EDGE Chase Young.

Updated 2026-09-21: Minter's Week 2 postgame/weekly press conference (his first loss as a head coach) — defended the failed 3rd-and-1 call, called penalties a "major point of emphasis," and cited third-down defensive breakdowns (coverage leverage, unabated pressure, missed tackles on checkdowns). Said the team has "a good shot with a lot of guys this week" (WR Zay Flowers, OT Ronnie Stanley, DT Nnamdi Madubuike all trending toward playing Week 3; final call expected Wednesday 9/23). ILB Trenton Simpson praised as "playing like one of our best players"; WR Rashod Bateman stepped up with Flowers out; CB Chidobe Awuzie flagged as needing more snaps. WR Ja'Kobi Lane placed on IR (wrist surgery) — out for the season. Attention now turns to the Week 3 trip to Rio de Janeiro to face Dallas.

Updated 2026-09-24 (Wed 9/23 practice report, latest official): DT Nnamdi Madubuike (neck) and ILB Teddye Buchanan (knee) both returned to FULL practice — trending toward their season debuts vs. Dallas. WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) and OT Ronnie Stanley (toe) both DID NOT practice Wednesday — still day-to-day and not yet cleared, a softer status than earlier in the week suggested (no Friday report out yet). OLB Trey Hendrickson (finger) DNP but played through it vs. the Saints in a cast and recorded his first sack; G John Simpson (groin) remains Limited. CB T.J. Tampa (knee) is off the injury report entirely. New names appearing Wednesday: DL Calais Campbell (DNP, appears to be a scheduled rest day after 40 snaps vs. Saints, not a new injury), WR Chris Moore (ankle), S Malaki Starks (hamstring), OLB Zion Young (quad) — all Limited. Minter flagged 12 penalties for 90 yards through 2 games as a point of emphasis; ILB Trenton Simpson again drew praise (6 tackles, 1 TFL vs. Saints). Team practices Wed/Thu in Baltimore, flies out Thursday night for Sunday's game at Maracanã Stadium in Rio; NFL confirmed no concerns about field conditions. Dallas also banged up: LB Demarvion Overshown, CB Cobie Durant, S P.J. Locke, S Malik Hooker all out/questionable. Market line moved toward Baltimore since 9/22: FanDuel now Ravens -178/Cowboys +150, spread Ravens -3.5 (was -158/+134, -3).
